text:
alex: quick handoff — i'm stepping out at 16:00 PT :wave: primary for this shift is @mira, secondary is @sam. brief recap of the morning paging: we had increased 5xxs on the relay edge in eu-west for ~25m, automatic fallback to smaller model pool kicked in, customer-visible latency spikes for batch embeddings (customers in logs: corp-acme, searchly). INC-3421 opened, assigned to @lina for root-cause tracking.

mira: thanks — copying runbook pointers. can you paste the quick mitigation steps and any ongoing tasks i should watch? also any gaps in coverage for night (apac)? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: mitigation checklist (already done):
1) scaled up relay-proxy replicas in eu-west (kscale +2)
2) forced routing to dedicated fallback model variant `redwood-embed-quant-fallback` for low-latency paths
3) invalidated a stale prefix cache entry for corp-acme via internal admin console

logs/commands I ran:
```
# scale command
kubectl -n relay set replicas relay-proxy 8 --record
# route change
curl -X POST https://api.internal/routing -d '{"policy":"force-fallback","target":"redwood-embed-quant-fallback"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

open tickets/links: INC-3421 (investigation), TICKET-789 (customer outreach), runbook: https://company.internal/runbooks/relay-edge-fallback

coverage note: apac night window (00:00-06:00 UTC) currently only has oncall coverage via @sam (secondary) — we don't have a dedicated APAC shadow tonight. if a multi-region capacity exhaustion happens, mitigation will require infra help (paging infra-oncall).

mira: acknowledged. i'll be primary for the next 8 hours. action items i have now: 1) confirm fallback routing remains stable for next 2 hours 2) verify no regression in embeddings quality for corp-acme (ping @lina for eval) 3) schedule customer follow-up for TICKET-789 if we see residual errors after 30m.

sam: i'll be available as secondary and can cover apac spike if pinged, but heads-up — i've got a standing call at 23:15 UTC for 30m. if something pages then, escalate to infra-oncall or add quick paging to @lina.

lina: will run the post-incident eval now. quick note: corp-acme saw 12% token truncations because fallback model has shorter context. i'll attach a small repro and data to INC-3421. also starting a small batch of eval runs to check semantic drift.

oncall-bot: [incident] Pager: INC-3421 triggered by relay-edge-5xx-rate > 5% for 15m. Severity: sev3. Affected customers: corp-acme, searchly. Link: https://incidents.internal/INC-3421

mira: current plan: keep routing forced to fallback for 60m, monitor latency SLO and error rate. if error_rate < 1% and latency < 300ms for 30m, revert to normal routing during low-traffic window (approx in 2h). if we see error spikes or the fallback causes unacceptable quality regressions, we will: 1) roll back routing and 2) open a quick incident bridge with infra.

alex: FYI i've created follow-up tickets: OPS-1142 (improve cache invalidation automation), DOC-56 (add fallback model quality checklist to runbook), and scheduled a retro for tomorrow 15:00 PT.

mira: assigning owners on the action items here: OPS-1142 -> @sam, DOC-56 -> @lina, customer follow-up / comms -> me. is that ok?

sam: ack OPS-1142 assigned to me. will start a small spike to automate the cache prune task.

lina: ack DOC-56, i'll draft the quality checklist and drop into the runbook page by EOD.

mira: scheduling: retro + postmortem review tomorrow at 15:00 PT (Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/999999999). i'll create the calendar invite and attach the initial timeline. please add any logs or notes to INC-3421 before the retro. :spiral_calendar: 

oncall-bot: reminder: please update your on-call status if you can't be reached. (https://oncall.internal/status)

mira: final notes before i take full responsibility: there is a small coverage gap for apac nights if a second correlated event occurs — already noted in the handoff. main risk: capacity pressure on dedicated pools could require infra intervention. i'm marking the handoff as complete now.

alex: thanks @mira — handing over with notes in INC-3421. i'm offline for the next 6h, reachable by emergency paging only. good luck. :thumbsup: 

mira: taking primary. ping me in this thread for quick context. closing handoff.

(threads like this often include short choppy check-ins; addendum: post-handoff follow-ups recorded in INC-3421 and OPS-1142)
